subject: Highlighting a set of scatter plot data points

messages.author: 51ad641b8e2d6e54
messages.subject: Highlighting a set of scatter plot data points
parts:
Hi,

I've found Shiny's page while looking for a way to create interactive graphs from R, but I haven't tried it yet. I'm looking for a specific thing I will probably need to do hundreds of times in the near future: creating a scatter plot of certain events (say, transaction times in a log file), with time on the x axis. I'd like then to be able to highlight the points of the same category (say, a specific exit/error code) to look for patterns. Ideally, I would imagine color fields on the graph's legend that highlight a a set of data points using the same color, on hover or click/toggle. Before I invest time and effort in learning Shiny, do you think it would be easy to do that? Sorry about a trivial question, but I couldn't tell after a quick look at the gallery and in the docs.

Thank you,
Greg
